name: @baerae/zkap-zkp-wasm
description: WebAssembly bindings for zkap-zkp — Poseidon hash and anchor generation. For proving/verification, use @baerae/zkap-zkp (Node.js).

scripts.build: wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir pkg --out-name zkap_zkp_wasm && node scripts/patch-pkg-name.mjs
scripts.build:web: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web --out-name zkap_zkp_wasm && node scripts/patch-pkg-name.mjs pkg-web
scripts.build:nodejs: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --out-name zkap_zkp_wasm && node scripts/patch-pkg-name.mjs pkg-node
